name: Cinder Storm (fire)
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level cleric/oracle 5, druid 5, inquisitor 5, magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner 5

EFFECT

Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This effect word deals 1d6 points of fire damage per caster level (maximum 15d6).
